notes: National rules; no region is needed. Revenue dates are the ROS (online) dates.

items.name: CRO Annual Return (Form B1) with Financial Statements
items.rule: Within 56 days after the Annual Return Date (first ARD: 6 months after incorporation; then each anniversary of it)
items.description: The first return needs no financial statements; later ones attach statements made up to a date no more than 9 months before the ARD. Late filing loses the audit exemption.

items.name: Annual General Meeting
items.rule: Within 9 months after financial year end, and at least once each calendar year
items.applies: Companies (an LTD may replace it with a written resolution)
items.description: Financial statements are laid before the members.

items.name: Register of Beneficial Ownership (RBO)
items.rule: Within 5 months of incorporation; changes within 14 days
items.description: Beneficial owners are filed on the central register as well as kept in the company's own register.
items.authority: Registrar of Beneficial Ownership of Companies

items.name: Branch — Filing the Foreign Company's Accounts with the CRO
items.rule: Each year, within the period the CRO sets after the company's accounts are published at home
items.description: The foreign company's accounting documents are delivered to the CRO annually.

items.name: Corporation Tax Return (CT1) and Balance of Tax
items.rule: 23rd day of the 9th month after the accounting period ends
items.description: Filed on ROS with payment of the balance.

items.name: iXBRL Financial Statements to Revenue
items.rule: Within 3 months after the CT1 due date
items.applies: Companies filing a CT1 (small companies may be exempt)
items.description: The financial statements are uploaded in iXBRL format.

items.name: Preliminary Corporation Tax
items.rule: 23rd day of the 11th month of the accounting period (large companies also pay on the 23rd of the 6th month)
items.description: At least 90% of the year's tax, or 100% of last year's for small companies.

items.name: Income Tax Return (Form 11) and Preliminary Tax
items.rule: 31 October (extended to mid-November when filed and paid on ROS)
items.applies: Sole traders and partners; partnerships also file Form 1 (Firms)
items.description: Pay and file: the return, the balance for last year and preliminary tax for this year.

items.name: Business Name Registration
items.rule: Within 1 month of starting to trade under a name other than the owners' own
items.applies: Sole traders and partnerships using a business name
items.description: Registered with the CRO; changes are notified within 1 month.

items.name: VAT Return (VAT3, every two months)
items.rule: 23rd of March, May, July, September, November and January

items.name: VAT Return of Trading Details (RTD)
items.rule: 23rd of the month after the accounting year ends
items.description: An annual breakdown of sales and purchases by VAT rate.

items.name: VAT Registration
items.rule: Within 30 days of passing the turnover threshold
items.description: Separate thresholds apply to goods and to services.

items.name: Payroll Submissions and Monthly PAYE, PRSI and USC Payment
items.rule: Payroll submission on or before each pay date; monthly return and payment by the 23rd of the following month
items.description: Revenue issues a monthly statement from the payroll submissions, which the employer accepts and pays.

items.name: Pension Auto-Enrolment (My Future Fund)
items.applies: Employers with eligible employees who are not in a pension scheme
items.description: Employer and employee contributions are deducted through payroll and paid to the central authority.
items.authority: National Automatic Enrolment Retirement Savings Authority (NAERSA)

items.name: Transfer Pricing Documentation
items.rule: Prepared by the CT1 filing date
items.applies: Companies with related-party arrangements (master file and local file above the group revenue thresholds)
items.description: Provided to Revenue within 30 days of a request.
